g.text: NIPS membrane discovery: robotic workflow and learning loop
Four zero curves + four sample curves per run • Hardware, analysis and experimental decisions
Preparation includes xArm coupon handling + 4 zero tests, bath chilling, and OT-2 preparation of 1000 µL casting dope.
Compression uses Arduino Uno triggering, Newton CSVs and LVDT safety / freshness checks. Pore fraction = fitted changepoint strain.
Solid arrows: process / dependency · Dashed arrows: records / offline review · Independent synthesis repeats are requested through the LLM prompt.
Cool bath · zero coupon · mix dope
